description:
Nonogram.com is an addictive logic game with a vast collection of picture cross puzzles. Due to their simple yet challenging gameplay, nonograms have become popular with people of all different ages. Join players all around the world, solve puzzles based on numerical clues and uncover the hidden picture!

Nonogram.com features thousands of puzzles with different levels of difficulty and in various categories, which are regularly updated to make sure the game never gets boring. Whether you just started playing nonograms or are already an experienced player, this game can definitely provide you with lots of fun and a pleasant pastime. Challenge your mind while solving nonogram puzzles and become a real Nonogram.com master!

Playing nonograms is also a good way to relax after a busy day and calm your mind. Escape from your daily routine and dive into a world of captivating puzzles! Enjoy the process of creating a picture from scratch based on numerical clues.

Let's start with the basic rules and logic behind picture cross puzzles:

• Color the squares and reveal the hidden picture.
• Use clues and numbers to solve the puzzles.
• Numbers above the columns are read from top to bottom.
• Numbers to the left of the rows are read from left to right.
• If you figure out that a square should not be shaded, mark it with an X.
• Get extra lives if you make a mistake.

Nonogram.com features:

• Plenty of nonogram puzzles with non-repeating images to color.
• Seasonal Events: complete time-limited events by solving nonograms of several difficulty levels. Reveal and collect all the unique postcards. Follow our updates to never miss a single event!
• Daily Challenges: solve puzzles every day and get a special monthly trophy!
• Tournaments: compete with other players and color as many nonogram pictures as you can. Choose a more difficult puzzle to practice your skills, earn more points, and win the top prize!
• Use hints if you get stuck while solving nonograms.
• Auto-crosses help you fill the grid on the lines where the squares are already correctly colored.

Nonograms are easy to learn and quite addictive once you start playing. Challenge yourself and enjoy hours of fun with Nonogram.com!
